desc:
⭐ Join group to get bonus cash when driving. 
⭐ Favorite and Like the game for in-game rewards.
✨Thank you for 130,000 likes! Code "130K". New code at 140,000 likes.

🚗 Collect over 80 different detailed cars and trims.
🔧 Customize paint, interior, rims, tint, and extensive performance upgrades. 
🌎 Explore detailed cities, scenic highways, twisty roads, and breathtaking landscapes.
🏁 Push the limits of your car and earn rewards through various live races!
🎵 Enjoy dynamic weather, stunning lighting, various radio stations, and car damage.

Corsa Legends offer realistic driving mechanics, including accurate aerodynamics, throttle control,
realistic physics, interactive infotainment, and dynamic lighting systems. Swap engines, experiment with different suspension setups,
and choose from a variety of tires, along with a super advanced tuning—enjoy limitless customization to make every ride your own.

This game is still in ALPHA, so expect BUGS. Any feedback is appreciated.
